entities.name: Andrus Öövel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrus Öövel is an Estonian rower and politician. From 1995 until 1999, he was Minister of Defence. He was a member of VIII Riigikogu. He was a 24-time champion of rowing in the Estonian SSR between 1974 and 1984.
